description: Search Daft.ie by county, price, bedrooms, bathrooms and recency, or paste Daft.ie search and listing URLs. Every record is one property.

bathroomsMax.description: Only return properties with at most this many bathrooms. Leave empty for no maximum.
bathroomsMax.title: Maximum bathrooms

bathroomsMin.description: Only return properties with at least this many bathrooms. Leave empty for no minimum.
bathroomsMin.title: Minimum bathrooms

bedroomsMax.description: Only return properties with at most this many bedrooms. Leave empty for no maximum.
bedroomsMax.title: Maximum bedrooms

bedroomsMin.description: Only return properties with at least this many bedrooms. Leave empty for no minimum.
bedroomsMin.title: Minimum bedrooms

county.description: Irish county or city to search. Choose All Ireland for a nationwide search.
county.title: County or city

includeDetails.description: Visit each property page to add the full description, feature list, Eircode, publish and update dates, view count and exact address. Slower and uses more requests.
includeDetails.title: Include full listing details

location.description: Optional Daft.ie location slug for a town, suburb or Dublin postal district, for example dublin-2-dublin, blackrock-cork or maynooth-kildare. Overrides County or city when set.
location.title: Advanced location slug

maxItems.description: Maximum number of property records to save.
maxItems.title: Maximum listings

mode.description: Which Daft.ie market to search: homes for sale, rentals, house shares, new homes, student accommodation, or commercial property.
mode.title: Search mode

priceMax.description: Highest price in euros. For rent and sharing searches this is the monthly rent. Leave empty for no maximum.
priceMax.title: Maximum price (EUR)

priceMin.description: Lowest price in euros. For rent and sharing searches this is the monthly rent. Leave empty for no minimum.
priceMin.title: Minimum price (EUR)

propertyType.description: Optional property type. Residential types work in residential modes; commercial types work in commercial modes. Leave on All types for every type.
propertyType.title: Property type

publishedSince.description: Only return listings first published within this window.
publishedSince.title: Added in last

sort.description: How Daft.ie should order the search results.
sort.title: Sort order

startUrls.description: Optional Daft.ie search URLs or individual property URLs. Search URLs keep the filters set on Daft.ie and are paginated automatically. When supplied, start URLs override the mode, county and filter fields above.
startUrls.title: Daft.ie search or listing URLs

title: Daft.ie Property Search Input
